content:
# Revision Notes v1.3

- Removed every playable biological-origin catalog, inherited-trait package, subtype registry, and pair-generation file.
- Removed biological-origin package selectors and identifiers from character creation and the online character schema.
- Replaced the former biological-origin chapter and appendix with the Twenty-Two exclusive terraforming mandates.
- Assigned all 40 listed biome variants to exactly one Architect with no overlap; every Architect has at least one assignment.
- Removed every former Architect association with generated inhabitants and revised affected titles/domains toward environmental responsibilities.
- Preserved all 22 classes, all six paths per class, all class-expression point-buy rules, all eight alignment axes, and all 81 alignment mappings.
